purpose: An inline reference in generated text, the inline citation of ChatGPT and Cloudscape: a small rounded chip with the mark of the source's site (its favicon, its icon, or its first letter on a colour of its own) and the site's name (`Azion`, else the host of `href` without `www.`), and `+N` when one marker cites several sources (`[1][2]`, `[1, 2]`). Hovering, focusing or pressing the chip opens a card with the site, the linked title and a snippet (`description`); with several sources a pager `‹ 1/3 ›` steps through them. `StreamingResponse` renders it for every run of `[n]` markers.
useWhen: A statement in a generated response that comes from one or more specific sources.
avoidWhen: A link the reader is meant to follow as part of the prose → a normal link.
related: `sources` — the pill and panel that list every source of the response.
bestPractices: Number in order of first use: [1], [2], [3]; the numbers stay in the accessible name.
Give each web source a `site` name (`Azion`, `GitHub`) and, when you have one, its favicon as `image`; a bare host reads as a URL.
Keep `description` to a sentence or two of the page; the card cuts it at three lines.
